# Le Cong Hoan

> Full-stack Engineer based in Hanoi, Vietnam, specializing in Angular Micro-frontends, Next.js, Go microservices, Java Spring Boot, high-scale database workflows (Oracle, PostgreSQL), automated CI/CD pipelines, and multi-node Kubernetes (K3s) Homelab infrastructure. Born April 2, 2002. Graduated with an Engineer Degree in Information Technology with Distinction from the University of Transport and Communications (UTC).

Le Cong Hoan is a Full-stack Engineer and System Builder experienced in developing enterprise process automation systems (EPAS), cloud-native multi-tenant FinOps architectures (Arda Labs), and educational platforms (Puchidemy, MochiMochi).

## Technical Notes & Articles

- [Designing Arda: A Cloud-Native Financial Operations Platform](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/designing-arda-cloud-native-finops-platform): Comprehensive system design of Arda (arda.io.vn) — 9 Go microservices, synchronous gRPC, NATS domain events, BFF auth-gateway proxy, CloudNativePG HA, Zeebe workflow, and K3s GitOps.
- [Authentication Beyond JWT: Designing Arda's Identity Architecture](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/authentication-beyond-jwt-arda-identity-architecture): Deep dive into why browsers shouldn't juggle raw JWTs: Traefik ForwardAuth, auth-gateway BFF, Ory Kratos (Identity), Ory Hydra (OAuth2/OIDC), and downstream header injection.
- [Reliable Domain Events with NATS and the Transactional Outbox Pattern](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/reliable-domain-events-nats-transactional-outbox): Solving the dual-write hazard in distributed Go services: writing business state and domain events atomically in PostgreSQL, relaying via NATS JetStream, and enforcing idempotent consumer deduplication.
- [Putting BPMN Behind a Workflow Service Boundary](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/bpmn-workflow-service-boundary-zeebe): Why domain services shouldn't talk directly to Zeebe: Designing a clean gRPC/HTTP workflow-service facade for case lifecycles, user tasks, SLA timers, and domain error handling.
- [What I Learned Building a Multi-Remote Micro Frontend Platform](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/multi-remote-micro-frontend-platform-module-federation): Architecting Arda's frontend with React Module Federation: 1 Shell host + 7 decoupled remotes sharing @workspace packages and avoiding shared state traps.
- [Running a Production-Like Platform on a Three-Node K3s Cluster](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/production-like-platform-three-node-k3s-cluster): Setting up a resilient self-hosted lab: 3 control-plane/worker nodes, CloudNativePG HA PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream, Valkey, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel, and ArgoCD GitOps.
- [Building Puchi: From Product Idea to Service Architecture](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/building-puchi-product-idea-to-service-architecture): Deriving backend service boundaries from product domain needs: Next.js PWA, Go Kratos v3 monorepo, NATS event bus, and Cloudflare R2 audio streaming.
- [Why Puchi Uses Opaque Sessions Instead of JWT Everywhere](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/why-puchi-uses-opaque-sessions-over-jwt): Architecting authentication for language learners: opaque bearer tokens, centralized revocation authority, internal session introspection, and caching trade-offs.
- [Git Push to K3s: Building Puchi's GitOps Deployment Pipeline](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/git-push-to-k3s-puchi-gitops-pipeline): Automating zero-touch continuous delivery: GitHub Actions container builds, GHCR registry publishing, and declarative ArgoCD synchronization on a multi-node K3s cluster.
- [Designing a Story-Based Language Learning Engine](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/designing-story-based-language-learning-engine): Domain modeling for interactive language learning: City -> Story -> Scene -> Content -> Activity hierarchy, separating static pedagogical curriculum from dynamic learner progress.
- [Designing Angular Micro-Frontends for Enterprise Applications](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/angular-microfrontend-architecture): How to structure Nx monorepos, module federation, shared UI libraries, and synchronized routing across independent enterprise teams.
- [Reflections on Graduating as an IT Engineer (Distinction) & Transitioning to Production Systems](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/from-utc-engineer-to-production-systems): Personal and technical reflections on graduating with distinction from UTC, computer science fundamentals, and stepping into enterprise engineering.

## Featured Systems & Projects

- [Arda — Multi-Tenant Financial Operations Platform](https://arda.io.vn): Cloud-native platform with 9 Go microservices (gRPC & NATS), React Module Federation (7 remotes), Ory IAM, and CloudNativePG on 3-node K3s.
- [Puchi — Vietnamese Language Learning Platform](https://puchi.io.vn): Next.js PWA with 5 Go microservices (Kratos v3), Limen Auth, NATS event bus, and declarative ArgoCD GitOps on K3s.
- [EPAS — Enterprise Process Automation System](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Enterprise-scale micro-frontend and microservice platform with CRM/BPM workflow automation built on Angular, Nx, Spring Boot, Kafka, Keycloak, and Kubernetes.
- [Enterprise CI/CD & Kubernetes Homelab Infrastructure](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Automated container pipelines, private registry, Longhorn distributed storage, and multi-node K3s cluster orchestration.
- [Zalo OA Integration & Message Management Platform](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Enterprise communication console for conversation filtering, broadcast template administration, and Spring Boot REST integration.
- [MochiMochi Language Learning Platform](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Learner-facing web applications with Next.js App Router, Core Web Vitals optimization, and modular TypeScript components.
